profile.name: Te Xiao
profile.headline: From Flexible Sensors to Wireless Biomedical Systems.
intro: I develop flexible electronics, biomedical sensors, and RF / wireless sensing systems at Waseda University, with a focus on smart contact lenses. My hands-on experience spans sensor and antenna fabrication, device integration, prototype testing, and experimental validation.
I am interested in industry R&D roles where I can turn device concepts into fabricated, measured, and validated prototypes.

paragraphs: My work connects materials and microfabrication with wireless biomedical systems. I have developed PEDOT-based resistive sensors and wrinkled-gold capacitive sensors, fabricated stretchable miniature gold antennas, and contributed to PT-symmetric wireless readout integration.

In the AMED-supported smart contact lens project, I prepared sensors and evaluated integrated devices in collaboration with Vizionfocus. Since October 2026, I have worked as a Research Assistant on the Moonshot Research Project, fabricating flexible sensing elements and evaluating contact lens biosensor prototypes.
I also served as a Laboratory Teaching Assistant at Waseda University (November 2020–January 2021), supporting water-electrolysis experiments, equipment operation, and analysis of results.

skills.label: Device Fabrication & Microfabrication
skills.detail: Photolithography, gold evaporation and electroplating, EDOT electrochemical polymerization, thin-film release and transfer, and hydrogel preparation; miniature gold antenna fabrication, flexible device integration, and prototyping.

skills.label: Sensors & Flexible Electronics
skills.detail: Design and fabrication of resistive and capacitive sensors; PEDOT:PSS and PEDOT:PSS/PVA film preparation, acid treatment and formulation optimization; processing and integration of hydrogels, PDMS, Ecoflex, and wrinkled gold.

skills.label: RF / Wireless Measurement & Simulation
skills.detail: HFSS electromagnetic simulation, LC resonant circuits, PT-symmetric wireless sensing, flexible antennas, resonance characterization and S-parameter measurements; VNA / LCR measurements, circuit soldering, and RF debugging.

skills.label: Testing & Data Analysis
skills.detail: Sensor response and prototype performance evaluation; experimental data collection, curve fitting and visualization in MATLAB and DataGraph; ex vivo porcine-eye and in vivo rabbit-eye validation.

skills.label: Engineering Software
skills.detail: HFSS for electromagnetic simulation; MATLAB and DataGraph for experimental analysis; Shapr3D for 3D modeling; familiarity with Blender.

about.credentials: Languages: Japanese (JLPT N2) and English (CET-6). Driving qualifications: Chinese motor vehicle driving licence and Japanese ordinary motor vehicle driving licence.
